text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おい大将、追いつかれて囲まれたぞ。
今度はどうするんだ？
text.official_en:
Looks like we're surrounded, Talimun. Tell me
you've got a plan.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なら、方針を変更して、
ここであいつらを迎え撃つぞ。
text.official_en:
Working on it. We need to change our approach—
push them back, if we can.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういうことなら、
遠慮なくひと暴れといくか。
text.official_en:
Shoulda said so earlier. Been looking for a reason to
cut loose.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なに、ここは街中だ。派手にやってりゃ、
治安維持の兵士たちがやってくる。
text.official_en:
Remember, we're still in the city. Make too big a
show, and we'll have soldiers raining down on us too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そうなりゃ、逃げ出すのはあいつらのほうさ。
それまで持ちこたえてくれ。
text.official_en:
And if that happens, everything could go sideways.
We'll have to wait this out.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
本当に、愚かな男……冥府に送る前に、
せめて名前を聞いておいてあげようかしら。
text.official_en:
You're a truly foolish man, aren't you? Well, the least
I can do is ask your name before I kill you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ヴァンダル商会のタリムーンを知らないのか？
ここいらじゃ、結構有名なんだがな。
text.official_en:
Never heard of Talimun of the Vandahl Trading
Company? Well, that's quite a surprise.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
タリムーン……？
ヴァンダル商会の……？
text.official_en: Talimun? Of the Vandahl Trading Company?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ひとつ、演奏してあげようかしら。
極上の気分を味わわせてあげるわ。
text.official_en:
Perhaps I should play instead. I promise, you've
never felt anything like it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
天にも昇る気持ちの中で……
冥界に堕ちなさい。
text.official_en:
Feel as though you're rising into heaven...as you
plummet into the underworld.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.official_en: *gasp*

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どうして……？
この呪歌を聞きながら、なぜ動けるというの……
text.official_en: How? How can you move while listening to this?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.official_en: Don't tell me... You're...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういえば、確かに面影がある……
思い出したくもない、あの男の。
text.official_en: I see it. The resemblance... To that sailor!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ほう？　妙な話だな。こっちはあんたの事は
覚えはないんだが、そっちは違うらしい。
text.official_en:
Huh? Strange. I think I'd remember a face like yours.
If we've met, I guess I left quite the impression.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ええ……完全に思い出したわ。
お前は……私の手で絶対に殺す！！
text.official_en:
That is who you are, isn't it? If that's the case, I'll
strangle the life out of you with my own hands!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
な……なんだよ、一体。
わからねえな。
text.official_en: Eh? I must be missing something here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
俺様は、いつの間にあんたから
そんなに恨まれたんだ？
text.official_en: Must've said something to end up on your bad side.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……成程、面白い。
お前の言っていた通りだったな。
text.official_en: Interesting. It is just as you said.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……タリムーンさんよ、まさか、これが
お前の言ってたもう一つの策ってやつか？
text.official_en:
Hey, Talimun, don't tell me this is the other plan you
were talking about?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういうことさ、シモン。
それにしても、本当に来てくれるとはな！
text.official_en: Yup! But I'm as surprised he came as you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そりゃいいが、こいつはとんでもないな。
生まれついての殺し屋って雰囲気だ。
text.official_en:
This guy... I've seen his type before. He's got the
aura of a natural-born killer.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この男を見てるだけで、
背筋に冷や汗が浮かんでくるぜ。
text.official_en:
Just looking at him makes me wanna reach for
my weapon.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
――お前は、あの時の男！
馬鹿な、どうしてここに……！？
text.official_en: You... I remember you! What are you doing here?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういえばお前とも……
死合ってみたいと思っていた。
text.official_en: Ah, it is you. I had thought to seek a duel with you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お前は……あの男などよりも、
よほど使えそうに見えるしな……
text.official_en:
There is much more to you than there was to
that lout.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……本当に、面倒くさい男。
そして、誰よりも美しい……
text.official_en:
You're as troublesome as the rest. But more
beautiful than the rest as well...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……これ以上、こんなところで暴れていると、
兵士たちが駆けつけてくるわね……
text.official_en:
We're out of time, it seems. Linger any longer, and
we'll have soldiers to deal with too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そろそろ潮時ね。
悪いけど、今日の所は命を預けておくわ。
text.official_en:
Apologies, but I can't finish killing you right now.
Lucky you. Enjoy your breath while you still have it.

text.jp: <TEDF>
text.official_en: <TEDF>
